# .github/scripts/skip-allowlist.txt -- Patch Q01.
#
# The ONLY reasons a CI test may be skipped.  check_skips.py reads the JUnit
# report of each test job and fails the job for any skip whose reason is not
# matched here.  Keep this list short: every line is a hole in the safety net,
# so every line says why it is acceptable, and "install the tool in the job"
# is always preferred to adding a line.
#
# Format (see check_skips.py):   scope | text found in the skip reason [| when=ENV_VAR]
#   scope     m2c, backend, protocol, or * for every job
#   when=VAR  the entry is active only while environment variable VAR is "1"
#
# Deliberately NOT here, because the jobs install what those tests need and a
# skip for them means the install broke:
#   - ripgrep / "rg"             (m2c job: apt install ripgrep)
#   - jsonschema                 (m2c job: pinned from protocol/requirements.txt;
#                                 backend job: pinned in requirements.txt; the
#                                 protocol job: protocol/requirements.txt)
#   - "root ignores file permissions" (the hosted runner is not root; a root
#                                 runner would silently drop the permission tests)

# --- m2c --------------------------------------------------------------------
# The real sandbox tests (WP C11a) need bubblewrap to create a user namespace.
# The m2c job probes this on the runner and sets M2C_CI_NO_USERNS=1 only when it
# is NOT possible (Ubuntu 24.04 restricts unprivileged user namespaces through
# AppArmor; the probe step tries to lift that first).  So this entry can only
# excuse the skip on a runner where the sandbox really cannot work: if
# bubblewrap works there and a sandbox test still skips, the job fails.
# C11a's tests must use exactly this wording as their skip reason (or change the
# line here in the same patch).
m2c | bubblewrap user namespaces unavailable on the runner | when=M2C_CI_NO_USERNS

# --- backend ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Real-Postgres tests (tests/integration/test_*_pg.py).  They need a scratch
# database with the minime_app role and every migration applied; the hosted
# runner has no Postgres service in this workflow, so they cannot run here.
# They are the one large block of tests CI does NOT exercise; run them by hand
# (README.md, "Real-database tests") before a change that touches SQL.
backend | MINIME_TEST_DATABASE_URL not set
# FreeCAD geometry-kernel tests (tests/unit/test_mech_validator.py).  FreeCAD is
# not pip-installable and is not installed on the runner.
backend | real FreeCAD install required for geometry-kernel tests
